clips.title: The story
paras: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, hungry patrons wait for Ragnar Thunderbrew's famed ribs. His regular meat supplier is away with the King's Army, so Ragnar needs fresh crag boar ribs and Rhapsody Malt to keep them on the menu.

The Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos is known for hearty dwarven ale and hearty tavern fare. Its famed Beer Basted Boar Ribs are among the favorites. But tavern keeper Ragnar Thunderbrew has a bare pantry: the local hunter who supplied fresh meat enlisted in the King's Army to reinforce the Alliance front. Eager customers still fill the tavern, and Ragnar needs passing travelers to help keep the ribs on the menu.

Fresh crag boar meat comes from the tough animals roaming the snowy foothills around Kharanos. Ragnar's recipe also calls for fresh Rhapsody Malt, drawn straight from the distillery's taps. The malt softens the tough game meat and turns it into a savory feast fit for a dwarf's praise.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs! Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front.

Maybe you can help me out? If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample! The secret's in the Malt!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
